Inline markers inside a code span stay literal content

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p><code>a<em>b</em><ins>c</ins></code></p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
